prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
engine_stated_criteria: Best if you want ongoing monitoring and more features
answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best single service** to check whether AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business, **OwlSearch AI** is the strongest fit from the results you provided because it explicitly tracks recommendations across **ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity** and tells you **who AI recommends instead and why**.[1]

If you want the **best free quick check**, **HubSpot AI Search Grader** is a solid option because it offers a **free one-time** visibility snapshot across **ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini**.[9] Another free alternative is **Guzu AI**, which says its free GEO audit includes an instant ChatGPT check plus coverage of ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, along with an action plan.[5]

A practical way to choose:

- **Best overall for a small business:** **OwlSearch AI** for direct recommendation tracking and competitor comparison.[1]
- **Best free baseline:** **HubSpot AI Search Grader** or **Guzu AI**.[5][9]
- **Best if you want ongoing monitoring and more features:** tools like **Otterly.AI**, **Semrush AI Visibility**, or **Profound** appear in the comparisons, but they are more subscription-oriented.[8][12]

One important caveat: these services can check whether AI systems currently mention or recommend your business, but no source here suggests any tool can **guarantee** placement in ChatGPT or other AI answers.[20]
